entities.summary: Janne Heiskanen (b. 1979-01-26, Helsinki) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Helsinki and Finland. Known in the fields of finland, composers & musicians, europe.
